## 示例：Markdown + Python + LaTeX

簡單因子模型下的預期年化收益為：

$$
E[R_i] = R_f + \beta_i (E[R_m] - R_f)
$$

```{python}
import numpy as np

risk_free = 0.015
beta = 1.2
market_premium = 0.06
expected_return = risk_free + beta * market_premium
expected_return
```
